name: Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS, 1991–1996)
description: A white field bearing the letters 'C.I.S.' in blue serif capitals across the centre.
history: A provisional flag used by the Commonwealth of Independent States after its creation in December 1991, most visibly for the Unified Team at the 1992 Olympics and the CIS side at UEFA Euro 1992. Replaced by the blue flag with the gold emblem adopted on 19 January 1996.
